associations: Treat startup as staged evidence accumulation, not as immediate extraction.
Use source-local observables available before the main controller wakes.
Count anti-backdrive and handoff correctness as first-class metrics, not side effects.
blind_spots: Comparator/latch thresholds may still be unrealistic below 20-50 mV unless modeled carefully.
Probe overhead can collapse the advantage if source recovery is slower than assumed.
Any hidden helper behavior would collapse novelty against helper-assisted cold-start work.
anomaly_results: Mixed-polarity startup favors scout-bucket concepts over direct common-reservoir concepts.
Ultra-slow ramps make handoff gating almost as important as extraction path choice.
High impedance asymmetry makes ranking/sequencing concepts more attractive than steady-state extraction concepts.
